description: The physical rules governing Cordelia's kind, including the effects of the binding ritual.
rules: Rules must be applied consistently throughout, particularly after the unbinding in Chapter 21 where all powers should return fully.

Normal State.Abilities: Shadow-stepping, mist manipulation, predatory speed and strength
Normal State.Vulnerabilities: Holy water, silver, crucifix proximity, direct sunlight (painful, not immediately fatal)

Under Binding.Physical State: Vulnerable, weakened, cold affects her, sunlight no longer painful

After Unbinding.Trigger: Elijah removes the crucifix to save her life during wendigo fight (Ch. 21)
After Unbinding.Implication: She willingly submits to rebinding for the tribunal (implied Ch. 26, needs explicit address)
